archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & SWISS COMMAND CENTER
design_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism & Data High-Density. Designed like a mission control deck for global multi-echelon supply networks. High visual clarity, zero decorative blur or purple gradients, sharp 1px borders, high-contrast status triggers, and graph-first interactive exploration.

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + Custom CSS Variables + Lucide Icons / Radix UI / Phosphor Icons

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
scale.kpi_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tight

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Mode B: High Density Command Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 / grid-cols-12)

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) with sharp outer edges
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard tactical offset shadow: shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] or flat border framing
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Subtle 1px cell grid divisions across dashboard widgets
visual_enhancers.status_indicators: Animated pulsating dot (h-2 w-2 rounded-full) for active disruptions and real-time simulation runs
visual_enhancers.badging: Sharp monospace pill badges with status background tints (e.g. bg-red-950/60 text-red-400 border border-red-800)

cytoscape_network_guidelines.controls: Zoom in/out, fit view, layout selector (Dagre / CoSE / Concat), node search, risk filter drawer

page_blueprints.title: Authentication & Role Access
page_blueprints.layout: Centered mission-control card over subtle dark topological grid pattern
components: Brand identity banner with live connection status pill
Role selector tabs (ADMIN, ANALYST, VIEWER) for demo login pre-fill
Email & Password input fields with high-contrast active ring
Role capabilities breakdown panel (describing algorithm access and edit permissions)

page_blueprints.title: Executive Resilience Center
page_blueprints.layout: 4-Column High Density Metric Grid top, split 8/4 grid bottom
components: KPI Cards: Network Resilience Score (0-100), Active Disruptions Count, Estimated Revenue at Risk ($M), Mean Recovery Time (Days)
Mini Interactive Cytoscape Snapshot Widget showing top critical bottlenecks
Top 5 Critical Echelon Nodes table with risk meters and revenue weight
Live Simulation Activity Feed & Disruption Alerts stream

page_blueprints.title: Interactive Multi-Echelon Network
page_blueprints.layout: Full-bleed workspace with sticky filter drawer on left and detail sidebar on right
components: Cytoscape Canvas with pan/zoom/node-drag and custom layout selector
Echelon filter checkboxes (Suppliers [12], Manufacturers [4], Warehouses [5], Customers [12])
Lane flow capacity & product filter dropdowns
Node Inspector Drawer: capacity, lead time, single-point-of-failure risk flag, connected lanes

page_blueprints.title: Disruption Scenario Simulator
page_blueprints.layout: Split panel: Disruption Configurator (Left 4 cols) vs Impact Preview & Simulation Engine (Right 8 cols)
components: Disruption Builder: Select target node/lane, severity %, start day, duration (days)
Pre-set Scenario Quick-load buttons (e.g., Suez Port Blockade, Tier-1 Semiconductor Shortage, Warehouse Fire)
Discrete-time Simulation Trigger (14 Graph & Simulation Algorithms engine)
Real-time propagation forecast timeline preview

page_blueprints.title: Ripple Effect & Criticality Analysis
page_blueprints.layout: 3-Column layout with bottleneck tree, propagation heatmap, and financial loss chart
components: Criticality Ranking Table (Betweenness, Downstream Impact, Hub Risk Score)
Echelon Propagation Heatmap (Day-by-day inventory deficit per customer)
Financial Exposure Breakdown by Product Line & Geographic Region

page_blueprints.title: Recovery & Optimization Planner
page_blueprints.layout: MIP & Min-Cost Flow Parameter Workbench top, Strategy Recommendation Cards bottom
components: Optimization Constraints Form: Max budget cap, air-freight vs sea-freight toggles, lead time tolerance
Generated Recovery Strategy Cards (e.g., Primary Strategy: Reroute via Secondary Warehouse, Backup Strategy: Supplier Dual-Sourcing)
Cost vs Time tradeoff curve visualizer
Action Plan Execution Checklist for Operations

page_blueprints.title: Optimization Algorithm Output
page_blueprints.layout: Comparative Data Table & Dual-Axis Cost-Service Level Chart
components: Min-Cost Flow execution logs and solver convergence metric
Re-allocated Lane Capacities vs Baseline Comparison Table
Unmet Demand Reduction metrics and margin impact analysis

page_blueprints.title: Multi-Scenario Tradeoff Matrix
page_blueprints.layout: Side-by-side multi-card column comparison (Baseline vs Scenario A vs Scenario B)
components: Scenario Selector checklist (up to 3 concurrent scenarios)
Side-by-side KPI comparison cards (Resilience %, Cost Delta $, Days to Recovery)
Overlay Line Chart comparing cumulative revenue loss across scenarios

page_blueprints.title: Discrete-Time Day-by-Day Playback
page_blueprints.layout: Interactive Day Scrubber Header (Day 1 to 90) + Dynamic Network State Canvas
components: Time Play/Pause/Scrub bar with speed control (1x, 2x, 5x)
Day-by-Day Inventory Depletion graph with buffer stock threshold lines
Active disruption lifecycle status indicators

page_blueprints.title: Executive Resilience & Audit Reports
page_blueprints.layout: Document preview with export panel and audit log trail
components: One-click PDF/CSV Export buttons for Executive Board & Supply Chain Managers
Algorithmic Audit Log (tracking user role, parameters used, simulation run timestamp)
Executive Summary Template Generator

mobile_adaptation.strategy: Responsive command bar & stacked modular widgets
mobile_adaptation.navigation: Slide-out mobile navigation drawer with role indicator
mobile_adaptation.cytoscape_touch: Touch drag enabled, pinch-to-zoom, simplified node labels on screen width < 768px
mobile_adaptation.tables: Horizontal scroll wrappers with sticky left column for node/scenario identifiers

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, cytoscape control buttons, role selectors) must have distinct data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark command-center aesthetic with #070B12 background and #0F172A surfaces.
Use Amber (#F59E0B) as the singular high-visibility primary accent color.
Do NOT introduce purple gradients, cyan glow, or soft decorative shadows.
Ensure Cytoscape network is fully interactive with custom node styles matching echelon types.
Include synthetic data covering 12 suppliers, 4 manufacturers, 5 warehouses, 12 customers, ~30 lanes, ~24 products.
Ensure Supabase Auth handles ADMIN, ANALYST, VIEWER roles gracefully.
Attach data-testid attributes to all key inputs, action buttons, and navigation elements.
